environment: Local Next.js development preview, macOS in-app browser. Mobile is a resized viewport, not a physical phone.
method: Six automatic adjacent-photo transitions at 1.4-second intervals; freeze the last six seconds of sampling after 11 seconds. pageFps measures requestAnimationFrame cadence; activeMotionFps measures active Framer Motion onUpdate callbacks and is not a physical display/GPU frame counter.
scope: Warm adjacent previews, not cold-network loading. Normal viewer URLs do not run the performance probe.
